body:
I like the idea, it gives a lot of flexibility but... is more for advanced users that want full control. I'd rather try to focus on the usual use-cases for most of our users first.

If we follow your suggestion, users will have to define a method (`onDomNodeAdded`) to add their own method to the DOM element. They might have to workaround `this` binding, event delegation, etc. I'd rather we keep this complexity internally.

We could also add an `onDomNodeAdded` later on, but for now I'd rather focus on the common use-case.

WDYT?
